title: The Echo of Sector Nine
author: Ulyana Nystrom
blurb: Jonah Sandoval, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
